initial_large_verification_refusal: One4096-key16KiB verification call exceeded its default read budget. Timed batch calls up to256 succeeded. The incomplete attempt is excluded. Final verification uses1024-key calls.
node_bodies: SHA-256 hexadecimal text. This can compress before content encryption; nominal bytes do not imply device bytes.
os_cache: Unknown. Fresh command processes do not establish physical cold-device reads.
physical_bodies: Distinct SHA-256 byte chunks per record and chunk; no repeated text. Every997th body is empty; every251st key is deleted.
physical_updates: Distinct SHA-256 byte chunks per repeat, slot, and chunk; same nominal body size as the initial values.
written_bytes: Not instrumented. Map pages, file lengths, and allocated file bytes are reported separately.
